title: Concept: Microsoft IIS version disclosed in a response
description: An IIS version in an error page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The version dates the web server and confirms Windows hosting, which narrows the exploit families worth trying.
applicability: Deployments that render an IIS version in an error page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The version dates the web server and confirms Windows hosting, which narrows the exploit families worth trying.
